timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: It's your data governance platform. It scans, classifies, catalogs, and tracks lineage across your entire data estate.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: How does the data map work?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Auto-scan sources across on-prem, multi-cloud, and SaaS. Builds a map of every asset, classification, and relationship.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Labels like Public, Internal, Confidential. You can auto-apply them based on content, and they encrypt and restrict access.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Data lifecycle management — what does that mean?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Retention labels that auto-delete or archive data based on policy. No more hoarding data forever because nobody knows what to do with it.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: It tracks where data comes from and how it transforms. Critical for compliance — you can prove exactly how a report was generated.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: That sounds incredibly useful for audits.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: That's the point. Auditors love Purview because it answers their questions automatically.
